description: This file defines the ResourceManager class, which is part of the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares the class interface, including constructors, destructors, methods for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval, as well as internal methods for managing AV blocking and TTS resources. It also includes static constants for method names and manages internal state variables and external dependencies.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: A class implementing plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for resource management, including methods for AV blocking and TTS resource reservation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: setAVBlockedWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method for setting AV blocked status via JSON RPC.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplicationsWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method for retrieving blocked AV applications via JSON RPC.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method for reserving TTS resource via JSON RPC.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapperForApps
methods.description: Wrapper method for reserving TTS resources for multiple applications via JSON RPC.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Internal method to set AV blocked status for a client.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve list of applications with AV blocked status.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Internal method to reserve TTS resource for a client.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceForApps
methods.description: Internal method to reserve TTS resources for multiple clients.
